design: Paired player-cluster percentile bootstrap with fixed fitted predictions; all seasons for a sampled player move together. Reused 2024–2026 temporal test, not independent confirmation. This interval omits training/refit uncertainty.
interpretation: AUC delta above zero favors four components; Brier delta below zero favors four components. No interval here validates raw MiLB translation, a universal frontier, or next-year improvement.
